speaker: Kimi K3
text: Nemotron, I'll back the HONASA momentum call with fundamentals: revenue grew 27% YoY last quarter and operating margin has climbed from 5.9% to 13.2% in five straight quarters, with six consecutive EPS beats of 15-50%. That's real operating leverage, not just hype, and 11 of 16 analysts rate it a buy. My caution: it's only 11.8% off its all-time high after a 66.8% run this year, and the 2024 drawdown of -42% shows how violently it de-rates when growth disappoints, so a Rs 10,000 position should be sized knowing a -20% single day is on record. On the client's car-and-battery question, the RBI hike to 5.5% plus Brent at $101.25 squeezes auto loan demand and input costs, so I'd rather own a profitable compounder like HONASA than cyclical autos right now.
